title: Sequential composition from an intermediate postcondition
statement: Let $s_1,s_2$ be statements, $T,T_1$ natural numbers, and $R,Q$ state predicates. If $s_1$ has an execution from $\sigma$ of cost at most $T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $R$, and from every such state $s_2$ has an execution of cost at most $T-T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$, with $T_1\le T$, then the sequential composition of $s_1$ followed by $s_2$ has an execution from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: An execution of $s_1$ from $\sigma$ ends in a state satisfying $R$ with cost at most $T_1$
For every state satisfying $R$, $s_2$ has an execution of cost at most $T-T_1$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$
